unavailable.title: Can't reach the assistant
unavailable.description: The assistant isn't running, so this couldn't be loaded. This isn't an empty list.

error.title: Couldn't load this
error.description: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

status.waiting_count: {count} waiting for you | {count} waiting for you
status.offline_description: Its sidecar isn't running. Restart it to use the assistant again.

changes.overlapped: May include changes from another chat that ran at the same time.
changes.undo_note: Undo restores this file to the checkpoint and reloads the page. | Undo restores these {count} files to the checkpoint and reloads the page.
changes.redo_note: Redo puts this file back as the assistant left it. | Redo puts these {count} files back as the assistant left them.
changes.empty_description: When the assistant edits a page or a file, the change set lands here with its diff and an undo.
changes.off_description: Git isn't available on this machine, so the assistant can't save checkpoints to undo its changes. Install Git and restart the assistant.

diff.binary: Binary file, no diff to show.

undo.title: Undo change set #{number}?
undo.description: Restores {count} file to how it was before {when}. | Restores {count} files to how they were before {when}.
undo.conflict_title: {count} later change touches the same files | {count} later changes touch the same files
undo.only: Undo #{number} only, keep the lines of {later}
undo.no_conflict: No later change set touches these files.

toast.undone_description: The page reloads with the files as they were. | {count} change sets were undone; the page reloads with the files as they were.

skills.shadowed_by: Ignored: {winner} has the same name and is used instead.
skills.shadowed_description: Ignored: another skill has the same name and is used instead.

conflicts.title: {count} skills are named “{name}”
conflicts.description: The one from {winner} is used; {ignored} is ignored. Rename one to use both. | The one from {winner} is used; {ignored} are ignored. Rename them to use them all.
